getting-started-talking-to-denulth.text: Hello citizen, how can I help?

options.text: Do you have any quests for me?

steps.player: Do you have any quests for me?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: I don't know if you can help us!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: The trolls have taken up camp on Death Plateau! They are using it to launch raids at night on the village. We have tried to attack the camp but the main path is heavily guarded!

steps.player: Perhaps there is a way you can sneak up at night?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: If there is another way I do not know of it.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Do you know of such a path?

steps.player: No but perhaps I could try and find one?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Citizen you would be well rewarded!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: If you go up to Death Plateau be very careful as the trolls will attack you on sight!

steps.player: I'll be careful.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: One other thing.

steps.player: What's that?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: All of our equipment is kept in the castle on the hill.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: The stupid guard that was on duty last night lost the combination to the lock! I told the Prince that the Imperial Guard should've been in charge of security!

steps.player: No problem, what does the combination look like?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: The equipment room is unlocked when the stone balls are placed in the correct order on the stone mechanism outside it. The right order is written on a piece of paper the guard had.

steps.player: A stone what...?!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Well citizen, the Prince is fond of puzzles. Why we couldn't just have a key is beyond me!

steps.player: I'll get on it right away!
No, sorry.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Never mind citizen.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Can I assist you with anything else?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Welcome to the Principality of Burthorpe!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: We are the Imperial Guard for his Royal Highness Prince Anlaf of Burthorpe.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Can I assist you with anything else?

steps.player: You can't, thanks.

getting-started-talking-to-denulth-again.speaker: Denulth
getting-started-talking-to-denulth-again.text: Hello citizen, is there anything you'd like to know?

options.text: Can you remind me of the quest I am on?

steps.player: Can you remind me of the quest I am on?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: You offered to see if you could find another way up Death Plateau. We could then use it to sneak up and attack the trolls by night.

steps.player: Ah yes, and the guard had lost the combination to your equipment room in the castle on the hill?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: That's right citizen, you offered to recover the combination and unlock the door.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

options.text: I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?

steps.player: I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: You are right citizen. The White Knights have taken advantage of the old and weak king, they control most of Asgarnia, including Falador. However they do not control Burthorpe!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: We are the prince's elite troops! We keep Burthorpe secure!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: The White Knights have overlooked us, until now! They are pouring money into their war against the Black Knights, they are looking for an excuse to stop our funding and I'm afraid they may have found it!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: If we can not destroy the troll camp on Death Plateau then the Imperial Guard will be disbanded and Burthorpe will come under control of the White Knights. We can not let this happen!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

steps.player: That's all, thanks.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: God speed citizen.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-du.speaker: Dunstan
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-du.text: Hi!

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-du.speaker: Dunstan
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-du.text: I see you've got the spiked boots. Are you going to take them to the Sherpa?

new-route-up-death-plateau-trying-to-wea.text: The sherpa's feet must be very small; I can't get them on.
Trying to walk in these would be difficult. I'll carry them for now.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: Have you brought me the items I asked for?

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: These are expensive, do not lose another pair!

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing

You give Tenzing the loaves of bread and the cooked trout.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: Thank you very much traveller. I'm now ready for the winter!

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.player: You said you would show me the secret way to Death Plateau?

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: Yes, of course! I drew up a map in case I ever needed to use it again.
Tenzing has given you a map of the secret way!
Tenzing has given you a map of the secret way

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: I don't think the Trolls have found the secret way yet, if they had I would've been attacked by now.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.player: OK thanks but I think I'd better check the path. I don't want to send the Imperial Guards to their death!

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: You are wise for one so young.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: Hello again traveller. What can I do for you?

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.player: I've lost the secret way map.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: Never mind. I'll quickly draw you another one.
Tenzing has given you a map of the secret way

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.speaker: Tenzing
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-te.text: Hello again traveller. What can I do for you?

steps.player: I'm lost!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: To get back to Burthorpe follow the path going east.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: I thought you were going to investigate the secret way to Death Plateau? Use the back door to my hut, hop over the stile and follow that path.

steps.player: Oh yes, of course! Thanks!
Nothing, thanks.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Go in peace traveller.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-sa.speaker: Saba
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-sa.text: Have you got rid of those pesky trolls yet?

new-route-up-death-plateau-trying-to-cli.text: That looks dangerous. I'll need a good reason before I venture that way.

new-route-up-death-plateau-walking-far-e.player: I think this is far enough, I can see Death Plateau and it looks like the trolls haven't found the path. I'd better go and tell Denulth.

new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-du.speaker: Dunstan
new-route-up-death-plateau-talking-to-du.text: Hi! Did you want something?

options.text: Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
How is your son getting on?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: He is getting on fine! He has just started his basic training and has already been promoted to corporal! I'm really proud of him!

steps.player: I'm happy for you!

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Anything else before I get on with my work?

options.text: Is it OK if I use your anvil?

steps.player: I'm lost!

finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.speaker: Denulth
finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.text: Hello citizen, have you found the secret way up Death Plateau?

finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.player: Yes! There is a path that runs from a Sherpa's hut around the back of Death Plateau. The trolls haven't found it yet. The Sherpa made a map I can give you.

finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.text: If the player doesn't have the map:

steps.player: I don't have the map on me.

finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.text: If the player has the map:

steps.text: You give Denulth the map of the secret way.
You give Denulth the map of the secret way.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Excellent, this looks perfect. They will never see us coming.

finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.speaker: Denulth
finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.text: Have you managed to open the equipment room?
If the player doesn't have the combination:

steps.player: I have opened the door but I don't have the combination on me.

finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.text: If the player has the combination:

steps.player: Yes! The door is open and here is the combination.

steps.text: You give Denulth the combination to the equipment room.
You give Denulth the combination to the equipment room.

finishing-up-talking-to-denulth-after-op.text: If the player has not turned in all the items:
If the player has turned in all the items:

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: Well done citizen! We will reward you by training you in attack!

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: I shall present you with some steel fighting claws. In addition I shall show you the knowledge of creating the fighting claws for yourself.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: You are now an honorary member of the Imperial Guard!
Congratulations! Quest complete!
